title: Warm Hands
subtitle: The sea has one opinion about your lungs
description: The parish has buried four bell-raisers and all of them came up the
same way, which was not carefully. Wear the helmet. The helmet is
the parish's whole health-and-safety budget and it has never once
been worn by anybody who then drowned.
An item task that does not consume: carry it, and the task counts it
for as long as you keep it on you.
